blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Lok Sabha's presiding officers are the Speaker and Deputy Speaker.
The Vice President of India serves as the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.
Rajya Sabha also has a Deputy Chairman as a presiding officer.
Parliament convenes in three sessions: Budget Session, Monsoon Session, and Winter Session.
The gap between any two sessions of Parliament cannot exceed six months.

blocks.content:
Rajya Sabha:
• Chairman (Vice President of India)
• Deputy Chairman

items: The ex-officio Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is the Vice President of India.
The maximum permissible gap between two sessions of Parliament is 6 months.
The three regular sessions of the Indian Parliament are the Budget, Monsoon, and Winter sessions.

blocks.content:
There are three sessions of Parliament:
• Budget Session
• Monsoon Session
• Winter Session

The gap between two sessions should not exceed six months.
